arithmetic: Complete warm reset-state prediction plus visual encoding and dense heads. Separate these FLOPs from optimizer throughput and overhead; no existing CNN comparison is inherited.
clipping: Retain actual pre-update group norms/factors and existing post-update/activity measurements separately; do not infer group clipping events from the global norm.
decision: Each candidate is independently provisional only if KL improves in every paired seed and mean value MSE does not worsen. Retain every tradeoff and failure. No best checkpoint, best seed, or between-candidate winner is selected; promotion requires fresh-seed confirmation.
name: value-core-analysis-v1
pairing: Compare candidate minus reference on identical validation indices within each seed, then average paired predictions per position before resampling opening families. Report every seed difference and its sample SD separately.
scope: One optimization factor at equal labeled exposures on reused V0 validation families. Count actual learned-activity prediction FLOPs separately. No new matched-CNN or playing-strength claim, final-test labels, TPU use, topology change, or combined attachment/propagation/rate factor.
uncertainty: Opening-family bootstrap, 1000 resamples, seed 709; conditional family intervals and three paired-seed differences/sample SD separately. Two preregistered contrasts, no multiplicity correction; reused validation families.
